backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer backend, defining data types (TradePosition, TradeSummary, FeeOverview, AnalysisSession, etc.) and providing shared functions to store, retrieve, and manage trade analysis sessions with blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs and titles (timeframe selector, EMA/MACD/ATR adaptations for Trade Entry Checker) to their source files, components, and test requirement IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, hooks, utilities, and libraries.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React frontend, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing global state (analysis data, selected asset, active tab) and rendering a four-tab layout (Trade Analysis, Entry Checker, Orderbook Heatmap, Help/FAQ) with error boundary fallback UI.
Results display component that filters positions by selected asset and status, renders summary cards, charts, a positions table, asset selector, and fee overview inside a scrollable area with CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/components/AssetSelector.ts: A card component that lets users filter trade positions by asset, with search input and grouped dropdown (metals, stablecoins, cryptos), displaying stats for the selected asset.
frontend/src/components/ChartsSection.ts: Renders multiple Recharts visualizations (PnL bar chart, direction/liquidation pie charts, asset PnL distribution) for a set of trade positions, supporting asset-click filtering.
frontend/src/components/EntryChecklistRe: Displays a trade entry evaluation result as a summary card with a GO/WAIT/NO-GO verdict and a detailed condition checklist with pass/fail icons.
frontend/src/components/FeeOverview.tsx: Provides a comprehensive fee analysis dashboard with breakdowns by asset, direction, and category, plus optimization suggestions and fee-alpha scoring, rendered via Recharts charts and tabbed UI.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and app version with a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header component showing the Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer branding with a logo icon and subtitle.
frontend/src/components/HelpFaq.tsx: FAQ page component using an accordion to explain testnet vs. mainnet price differences and other common Hyperliquid trading simulation questions.
frontend/src/components/orderbook/Orderb: React component that renders an animated orderbook heatmap on an HTML canvas, smoothly interpolating between bid/ask data updates using requestAnimationFrame with configurable transition durations based on the update interval.
frontend/src/components/OrderbookHeatmap: React component that renders a live Hyperliquid orderbook heatmap with controls for symbol, depth, update interval, rendering mode (bars/cluster), and pause/refresh functionality. Uses the useHyperliquidOrderbook hook and delegates canvas rendering to OrderbookHeatmapCanvas.
frontend/src/components/PositionsTable.t: Displays a sortable, expandable table of trade positions grouped into metals, stablecoins, and other assets, with color-coded leverage, fee-alpha scores, and collapsible row details. Supports sorting by newest, oldest, or fee-alpha order.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCards.tsx: Renders a grid of summary stat cards (total positions, liquidations, PnL, metals PnL, stablecoins PnL) that adapt to a selected asset filter or show overall portfolio totals. Computes liquidation rate and conditionally shows metal/stablecoin cards based on available positions.
frontend/src/components/TradeEntryChecke: Form component that collects technical indicator inputs (EMAs, RSI, ATR, MACD) for a given timeframe and trade direction, validates them, and displays entry checklist evaluation results. Supports 1m, 15m, and 1h timeframes with different required fields per timeframe.
frontend/src/components/UploadSection.ts: Provides a drag-and-drop or file-input CSV upload interface that parses the file using parseCSV and passes the resulting analysis data to the parent via a callback. Includes validation for file type, size, and content with user-facing error and success toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both authenticated (Internet Identity) and anonymous access, and optionally initializing access control on actor creation.
frontend/src/hooks/useHyperliquidOrderbo: Custom React hook that polls the Hyperliquid API for orderbook data at a configurable interval, falling back to a backend actor if the direct fetch fails, and returns bids, asks, mid price, loading state, and error info.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP apps, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and exposing login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on analysis sessions and trade positions against the ICP backend actor, including session retrieval, storage with computed asset/metal/stablecoin stats, and related mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes, including primary, accent, chart, sidebar, and semantic colors.
frontend/src/lib/csvExporter.ts: Exports trade position analysis data to a CSV file with German column headers, including fee alpha metrics, asset categories, and direction labels, triggering a browser download.
frontend/src/lib/csvParser.ts: Parses CSV files containing trade position data, supporting German and English column names, headerless formats, and Hyperliquid-specific field mappings to produce structured TradePosition objects.
frontend/src/lib/feeAlpha.ts: Computes and aggregates 'Fee Alpha' metrics for trade positions, classifying fees as Captured/Paid/Neutral and calculating basis-point scores normalized by notional value, with grouping utilities by asset and direction.
frontend/src/lib/hyperliquidMarkets.ts: Defines a static list of supported Hyperliquid market symbols and provides helper functions for validation, sanitization, and retrieving the default market.
frontend/src/lib/hyperliquidOrderbook.ts: Parses and validates raw Hyperliquid orderbook data into a structured format with typed bid/ask levels and a computed mid-price.
frontend/src/lib/orderbookHeatmapRenderi: Provides canvas rendering utilities for an orderbook heatmap, including normalization, color interpolation, eased animation between orderbook states, and cumulative depth calculation.
frontend/src/lib/tradeEntryRules.ts: Defines and evaluates rule-based trade entry conditions for 1m, 15m, and 1h timeframes using EMA, RSI, ATR, and MACD inputs, returning a verdict (go/wait/no-go) with per-condition pass/fail details.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for CSS class merging, currency formatting, status/risk-level label and color mapping, asset categorization (metals, stablecoins), and position filtering helpers used throughout the frontend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters (supporting both regular and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining OKLCH-based design tokens (colors, border radius, shadows, animations) and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 20) describing the Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer app's architecture, existing features, known issues, and summary for build planning and AI context.
